Data: Railroad Commission of Texas orphan well list, October 2026, with well records compiled by Clearfork Intelligence
About the data

About the data

Orphan wells: the Railroad Commission of Texas lists a well as orphaned when it has been inactive for at least 12 months and its operator's required registration with the state (the Form P-5 organization report) has been delinquent for more than 12 months. This is the Commission's public list for October 2026: 12,473 wells, with 1,118 operators on record, across 203 counties and 7 offshore areas.

Color: how long the operator's registration has been delinquent, as the list reports it in months.

Locations: each well is drawn at the coordinates on the list. For 321 wells the list has none, and the location comes from the Commission's wellbore records. 7 more are drawn at the wellbore position because the list's coordinates were more than 1 km off and the wellbore position matched the Commission's own map. 197 have no usable coordinates in either source and are not on the map.

Well details: well type, depth, year completed and last production come from Railroad Commission wellbore and production records compiled by Clearfork Intelligence, October 2026. Oil or gas and the lease's production are shown only where the lease on the list is the lease on the wellbore record (11,520 wells). Production is reported by lease, so on an oil lease with several wells the last month may not be this well's, and some leases report production more recently than the list's definition would suggest. The production records start in Jan 1993.

What it can't tell you: the list changes every month as wells are plugged or taken over by another operator. Being on it does not tell you a well's physical condition. The wellbore records mark 198 of the listed wells as plugged; the sources can differ in timing.

The 12,473 wells on Texas's orphan list

Each dot is a well on the Railroad Commission of Texas orphan list for October 2026. The Commission lists inactive wells whose operator's state registration has been delinquent for more than a year. Color shows for how long. 197 more have no usable coordinates and can't be drawn. Wells on the state's orphan list for October 2026, colored by how long the operator's registration has been delinquent. 197 more can't be located.
